text: These numbers belong to the pulsar community. We did not discover the stars or re-measure their masses. We applied a pre-registered rule to published posteriors and stated the result per link. The famous mass ceiling test came close to the strict bar and stopped at serious doubt. The less watched binary test had already cleared its bar in the published literature. That is why neutron stars matter here. They turned a sweeping cosmic story into a test with an answer. This specific chain fails by the second rule its own authors wrote.
